videos.title: Has Instagram given up on celeb deepfakes?
videos.description:
A photo of Mia Goth wearing a t-shirt referencing her ex-husband Shia LaBeouf recently went viral, but it wasn’t real. The AI-generated image was posted by a fan-run Instagram account with a blue verification check, and was picked up by gossip sites and Google’s AI overview as legitimate. Has Instagram given up on fighting celebrity deepfakes?

videos.title: AI has come for Arizona's water
videos.description:
Arizona is a big player in the data center boom, but there’s one problem: there’s not enough water.

In 2019, TSMC, one of the world’s largest semiconductor companies, announced a chip factory bringing prosperity to the region. But those chips being made require 5 million gallons of water every single day. Now proposed data centers are facing community opposition, despite the fact that they would use less water than TSMC.
